title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki CheckUser Extension, specifically in the ipReveal.js module. This flaw affects versions from 1.46.0 up to but not including 1.46.3, and version 1.47. The vulnerability involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, which could allow an attacker with high privileges and partial user interaction to execute malicious scripts. The issue has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 4.8. No public exploits or patches are currently confirmed.
